title: Accessibility Statement | The Bridge
description: Draft accessibility statement for The Bridge Cannabis Experience. Final text comes from The Bridge's counsel before launch.
lede: We want this site to work for every adult who wants to use it.
draftNote: Draft for this preview. The Bridge's counsel supplies the final text before launch.

sections.heading: What we're aiming for
sections.html: Our intent is a site people can use however they get around the web: with a keyboard, with a screen reader, on a phone, zoomed in.

sections.heading: Tell us what's not working
sections.html: If something here gets in your way, tell us the page and what happened. Use the contact page or call 917-832-7420.

sections.heading: What the final statement will cover
sections.html:
• How the site is reviewed
  • How to ask for help with something on the site
